  from __future__ import annotations
  from pydantic import BaseModel, RootModel
  from typing import Optional, Union
  
  
  class Plain(RootModel[str]):
      root: str
  
  
  class Nullable(RootModel[Optional[str]]):
      root: Optional[str] = None
  
  
  class Either(RootModel[Union[Plain, Nullable]]):
      root: Union[Plain, Nullable]
  
  
  class Bound(RootModel[int | None]):
      root: int | None

      root: Union[Plain, int]
